2608.12097.title: Graph-Structured Rubrics: Compiling Rubrics into Typed Evaluation Graphs for LLM Judges
2608.12097.paper_summary: Rubric-based evaluators commonly treat rubrics as prompt context or flat criteria: they specify what to judge but leave criterion composition implicit, even when natural-language rules state it. We introduce Graph-Structured Rubrics (GSR), which compiles a rubric into a response-independent typed evaluation graph before observing responses. Criterion nodes elicit judgments; transformation, reduction, and gating operators compose them through named ports; and a task-specific output mapping, termed Readout, converts the unique sink into a score or preference. Compilation rejects malformed or type-incompatible graphs. Pointwise evaluation judges rubric dimensions separately before graph aggregation; pairwise evaluation reuses the graph with one judgment for each candidate under every criterion. Under GPT-OSS-120B, GSR improves exact score agreement by 0.62--6.75 percentage points over Prometheus-style scoring on four pointwise datasets and achieves the numerically highest end-to-end pairwise accuracy on two preference benchmarks under native tie and abstention policies.
2608.12097.paper_summary_zh: 評分標準的評估者通常將評分標準視為提示上下文或平面標準：他們指定要評判的內容，但對標準的組成保持隱含，即使自然語言規則已經說明了這一點。我們介紹了圖結構評分標準（GSR），它在觀察回應之前將評分標準編譯成一個與回應無關的類型化評估圖。標準節點引發判斷；轉換、縮減和閘控運算元通過命名端口將它們組合起來；而特定任務的輸出映射，稱為讀出，將唯一的匯聚點轉換為分數或偏好。編譯會拒絕格式不正確或類型不兼容的圖。逐點評估分別評判評分標準的維度，然後再進行圖的聚合；成對評估則在每個標準下對每個候選者重用圖，並給出一個判斷。在GPT-OSS-120B下，GSR在四個逐點數據集上相較於Prometheus風格的評分提高了0.62--6.75個百分點的準確分數一致性，並在兩個偏好基準下，在原生平局和棄權政策下實現了數值上最高的端到端成對準確性。
